metadata.name: Research implementation based on publicly documented criteria from Al Rajhi Capital
metadata.source_title: الضوابط الشرعية لمنتجات شركة الراجحي المالية (آلية احتساب العنصر المحرم)
metadata.scope: Founder-authorized 25-security US research draft only; provisional G1 decisions remain pending analyst review.
metadata.notes: Adapted independent research implementation, not affiliated with or endorsed by Al Rajhi Capital. Source verification, Shariah-analyst and legal review remain outstanding. The cited source has no cash or investment test. No approved Arabic description has been supplied; Arabic draft content must follow the marked review workflow.

version.notes: D-122–D-128 provisional adaptations; D-132 primary-activity interpretation. No cash or investment test in the cited source. Unverified, unpublished, no approval or production enablement.

criteria.label: Prohibited primary business activity
criteria.definition: Primary activity must be permissible. Provisional founder interpretation of الأغراض والأنشطة المباحة, pending Shariah-analyst review; not source verification.
criteria.formula_text: Fail if the classified primary activity is in the provisional prohibited list; unclassified is unknown.
criteria.treatment_rules: D-132: other valid classified categories are permissible for this criterion only; unclassified never passes; invalid categories are validation errors. D-80 tied-primary rules remain.
criteria.edge_cases: Unknown classification or missing segments requires review. No automated classification.
criteria.source_reference: الأغراض والأنشطة المباحة — provisional founder interpretation, not source-verified

criteria.label: Interest-bearing debt / market value basis
criteria.definition: Interest-bearing debt, excluding finance and operating leases, divided by adapted market_value_basis.
criteria.treatment_rules: D-122 launch rollover: newest complete quarter among the two latest completed quarters; fallback is stale. Missing equity/shares/closes or explicit multi-class/aggregated shares makes basis unknown. D-123 excludes both leases.
criteria.edge_cases: Unknown/nonpositive denominator blocks calculation. No allocation of aggregated shares.
criteria.source_reference: Supplied Al Rajhi Capital prohibited-income criteria PDF; founder provisional adaptations D-122/D-123/D-125/D-126/D-127; verification pending

criteria.label: Prohibited income / total revenue
criteria.definition: Gross annual prohibited income for the same annual period as total revenue.
criteria.treatment_rules: D-124: SEC interest-income proxy is estimated and incomplete, never assumed zero; sourced corrections must match the annual period. Estimated inputs may pass with reduced quality (D-125).
criteria.edge_cases: Unknown numerator requires review; unknown/nonpositive revenue blocks calculation.
criteria.source_reference: Supplied Al Rajhi Capital prohibited-income criteria PDF; D-124 provisional adaptation; verification pending
criteria.notes: Maximum 5%, no borderline margin. No cash or investment test.
